### Filter Details Decoded
The combination of filters defines the smart list's criteria:
1. Stage includes any of "B - Warm..." — contacts must be in warm stage(s)
2. Last Text Sent more than 14 days ago — haven't been texted recently
3. Last Sent Email more than 14 days ago — haven't been emailed recently
4. Last Call more than 14 days ago — haven't been called recently
5. Tags exclude any of: "complianc..." — excludes compliance-flagged contacts (DNC, TCPA, etc.)

The "Price — is between [empty, empty]" filter is visible but incomplete/inactive.

### The Empty State Explanation
The 0 results suggest that with ALL five filters active simultaneously (AND logic), no contacts currently meet all conditions — meaning every contact in the warm stage has had SOME form of communication in the last 14 days (call, text, or email), OR all contacts are excluded by the compliance tags filter.

## Data Model Signals

### Entities
- **Person/Contact:** Has Name, Stage, Source, Last Visit date, Pages Viewed (count), Properties Viewed (count), Properties Saved (count), Last Communication date, Calls Made (count), assigned Agent, Created date, Price (likely the price range of properties they've searched for or their budget), Tags
- **Smart List:** Has ID (numeric, e.g., 30), Name, Description text, Type ("PIPELINE" badge = Pipeline collection membership), filter criteria (saved permanently), display order in left rail
- **Collection:** A grouping of smart lists; "Pipeline" is a collection; "Neighborhoods" is another collection
- **Agent:** Has Name (assigned to contacts); appears as a column in the people table
- **Tag:** String labels applied to contacts; support "exclude" logic in filters (Tags exclude any of: ...)

### Fields / Enum Values Revealed
- **Stage values (partial):** "B - Warm..." (a stage name starting with "B - Warm" — likely "B - Warm" or "B - Warm Lead"); stage names appear to use a letter-prefix convention (B = Warm tier)
- **Filter operators for date fields:** "more than X days ago" (at least Last Text Sent, Last Sent Email, Last Call support this operator with a day count of 14)
- **Filter operators for Price:** "is not empty", "is less than", "is greater than", "is between [min, max]", "is empty"
- **Filter operators for Tags:** "exclude any of: [comma-separated values]" (tag-based exclusion logic)
- **Filter operators for Stage:** "includes any of: [comma-separated stage names]"
- **Smart list type flag:** "PIPELINE" (vs standard smart list) — pipeline collections have a badge; smart lists have a funnel icon in the rail instead of an emoji

### Relationships
- Person → belongs to one or more Stage values
- Person → assigned to one Agent
- Person → can have many Tags
- Person → has property search history (Pages Viewed, Properties Viewed, Properties Saved)
- Smart List → belongs to a Collection (Pipeline, Neighborhoods, or none)
- Smart List → has many filter criteria (each with field, operator, value)
- Smart List → has many saved view presets ("Out Of State Home...")

### Communication Activity Fields
- **Last Text Sent:** Date/timestamp (supports "more than N days ago" filtering)
- **Last Sent Email:** Date/timestamp (supports "more than N days ago" filtering)
- **Last Call:** Date/timestamp (supports "more than N days ago" filtering)
- **Last Communication:** Date/timestamp (table column, sortable; likely the most recent of any communication type)
- **Calls Made:** Integer count (table column)

### Non-Obvious Logic

1. **Smart List vs Collection Item:** The left rail shows two types of list items under "People":
   - **Pipeline Collection items** (emoji icons, blue count badges, can be nested under a collection name like "Pipeline") — these are curated groups with specific stage-based or behavior-based definitions; displayed with emoji icons which are user-configurable
   - **Smart Lists** (funnel/filter icon prefix) — these use the classic filter-driven definition; no emoji; also have count badges
   The "Warm/Bi-Weekly" is under Pipeline as a Collection item (has emoji icon + "PIPELINE" badge), not a standard Smart List.

2. **Filter count reconciliation:** "Filters (5)" counts only filters that have complete, non-empty values. The "Price — is between" filter with empty min/max inputs is shown in the panel but does NOT contribute to the "(5)" count.

3. **Filter panel layering:** The filters in the right panel are ADDITIONAL filters applied on top of the smart list's BUILT-IN criteria (accessed via "Edit"). The smart list has its own definition; the panel adds ad-hoc refinements for this session or as saved view filters.

4. **"Out Of State Home..." column preset:** The column set visible (including Pages Viewed, Properties Viewed, Properties Saved) is not the default — a named view preset has been selected. This preset name appears to be "Out Of State Home..." suggesting it was created for tracking out-of-state buyers viewing home listings.

5. **Pipeline Collection structure:** The Pipeline Collection appears to represent a lead nurturing funnel (Hot → Warm → Cold → Old) with built-in cadence reminders ("Bi-Weekly" = reach out every 14 days). The emoji icons appear to be user-assigned (configurable per collection item).

6. **Empty state behavior:** When the "No people match filters" empty state appears, the bulk action buttons in the toolbar may be disabled (grayed out) since there are no contacts to act on; the export/download may still be enabled to export an empty file [INFERRED].

7. **"Update List" mechanics:** Smart list membership is likely computed/cached for performance. "Update List" forces a recomputation; the button may show a loading spinner during refresh [INFERRED].

8. **Stage name convention:** The "Stage includes any of: B - Warm..." filter reveals that stage names use a letter-prefix system: "B - Warm" (and possibly "B - Warm Buyer", "B - Warm Seller", etc.). This suggests a tiered stage taxonomy (A = Hot, B = Warm, C = Cold, etc.) [INFERRED from visible partial text].

9. **TCPA compliance integration:** The "Tags exclude any of: complianc..." filter combined with the "TCPA Litigators — Hard Stop" smart list (132 contacts) reveals a compliance-aware contact filtering system. Smart lists that involve outreach (like Warm/Bi-Weekly) automatically exclude compliance-tagged contacts.

10. **URL structure:** `/2/people/list/30` — the "2" likely represents the account/team ID (Ryan Realty's FUB account), and "30" is the smart list ID. This URL pattern is consistent with FUB's multi-account architecture.
